description.p: Heroic is an Open Source Games Launcher for Linux, Windows and macOS. It can launch games from the Epic Games Store using Legendary, GOG using our own gogdl, Amazon Games using Nile, Steam and itch.io. On Linux, Windows games can be installed and played with Wine or Proton.
This is the beta build for Heroic 3.0. Bugs are expected, the stable channel is still on 2.22.4.

ul.li: Your Epic, GOG, Amazon, Steam and itch.io games in one library.
New interface with multiple themes, including a One Piece theme, and gamepad navigation.
Install, uninstall, update, repair and move games, with a download queue for multiple games.
Run Windows games with Wine or Proton, with an integrated Proton/Wine manager and Winetricks.
Cloud saves with path checks, backup on every sync and a restore option.
Backup Wizard to backup your logins, settings and game files, and to help migrating from Flatpak to other installs.
Import games installed through the Epic Store, GOG Galaxy or Steam.
Add games and applications from outside the supported stores, native or not, including browser apps.
Settings search, a new Add Game dialog with executable auto-detection and per-game settings.
Access store pages, ProtonDB, Metacritic and OpenCritic scores and the Heroic Wiki from the app.
Wine and Proton versions installed through Flatpak are not detected by Heroic. Use the built-in Wine Manager to download and manage them.
Heroic cannot access /usr/bin from inside the sandbox, so Wine and Proton installed there are not found.

description.p: First Beta for Heroic 3.0. Since its a beta, bugs are expected and the stable is still 2.22.4, so create a backup before testing on your main install.

ul.li: New design from scratch, Heroic Theme and Outfit font (#5489, #5932, #5964)
New themes, including One Piece (#6067)
Steam integration with Aurelia (#6045)
itch.io integration (#5706)
Cloud saves backup/restore (#6081) and new Backup Wizard (#5522)
Gamepad settings, settings search and new Add Game dialog (#6093, #6090, #6087)
Steam: some games won't start yet, and anti-cheat games probably won't work.
itch.io native Linux games are not supported yet.
Console mode still needs some polish for the new UI.
